journey.title: Steer a commission and wind it down without chat
journey.purpose: Direction and wind-down go into the operator file the supervisor re-reads, with the API saying when it will be read; controls act on the session only after a confirmation; nothing is typed into the supervisor's conversation.

steps.intent: Open a commission from Now and move to its Steer tab.
On an older charter, see that it does not read the operator file and enable steering with the exact sentence it adds.
Say a direction or wind down; confirm the dry run's exact entry and when it is read, as a warning when it waits for resume or steering.
Pause, resume or stop the session after confirming what is typed; a refused control shows the API's reason and offers Wind down instead.
